finding: Pre-existing: _handleVaultOperation catches DecryptFailedException and only invokes optional onDecryptFailed, without falling back to onError. The unlock/add/delete biometric handlers provide onError but no onDecryptFailed, so this exception is swallowed without a terminal biometric action. A showAuthenticationBottomSheet call waiting for biometricResultStream.first then remains pending. This rests on reading, not a run; the same missing terminal action existed before this diff and is unchanged by the round-1 fix.
recommendation: Separately make the DecryptFailedException branch invoke the supplied onError when no specialized handler exists, or supply a terminal biometric-failure handler on each affected operation, and pin the behavior with focused tests. Do not enqueue this pre-existing issue as an AW-2452 review fix.
